title: Spicy Chicken Khao Pad
description: A twist on the classic Thai stir-fry dish, this Spicy Chicken Khao Pad combines the bold flavors of India with the spicy kick of Thailand.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add the onion, garlic, and bell pepper.
Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the khao pad sauce and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or noodles and garnish with fresh cilantro.
Note: You can adjust the level of spiciness to your liking by adding more or less curry paste.
